_comment: Perf baseline — generated 2026-07-03 on linux-x64. Ratchet rule: budgets set at ceil(measured_max × 2) for startup, and at the stated SLO for frame timing (p95 ≤ 16ms). Regenerate with: bun run perf:baseline

renderer_load_ms.note: Time to cold-import compositor + buffer + grid from a fresh bun process. Budget = ceil(max × 2), rounded to 50ms. Ratchet: tighten budget when measured_max drops below budget/2.

composite_p95_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p95 over 200 full-repaint frames, 80×24 synthetic content. Budget = stated frame SLO (16ms). Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

composite_p99_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p99 over 200 frames. Budget = ceil(measured × 4), rounded to 10ms. Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

transcript.build_1k_ms.note: transcript Line[] build (1000 mixed msgs). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

transcript.append_one_ms.note: transcript append-one (warm per-message cache). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

transcript.resize_1k_ms.note: transcript resize (full width-change re-render). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

panel.two_pane_build_ms.note: panel-workspace two-pane frame build. Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

markdown.render_ms.note: markdown render (mixed document). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

codeblock.regex_ms.note: code-block render (regex fallback path). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

codeblock.treesitter_ms.note: code-block render (tree-sitter cache-hit path). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

overlay.open_ms.note: overlay open (help overlay frame build). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet: tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.
